findings.summary: The '7d' preset still calls daysAgo(7), unchanged from the pre-fix code. daysAgo(7) computes today-7, so the inclusive [from,to] window spans 8 calendar days — exactly the '8 instead of 7' bug the brief names as its primary example. Only '30d' and '90d' were corrected (to daysAgo(29)/daysAgo(89), which do span 30/90 days correctly). Verified arithmetically in Node (daysAgo(7) → span 8; daysAgo(29) → span 30; daysAgo(89) → span 90).
